title: Smoothness of C¹ weak solutions with small gradient of Δu = div G(Du), DG(0) = 0 (Schauder theory for the minimal surface system; Simon's proof of Theorem 5.7.1, last part)
statement: Let m ≥ 1, k ∈ ℕ and G : L(ℝ^m, ℝ^k) → L(ℝ^m, ℝ^k) be C^∞ with G(0) = 0 and DG(0) = 0. There is ε₀ > 0 such that for every open Ω ⊆ ℝ^m and every u : ℝ^m → ℝ^k which is C¹ on Ω with ‖Du(x)‖ ≤ ε₀ for x ∈ Ω and satisfies ∫_Ω Σ_j ⟨Du e_j, Dζ e_j⟩ = ∫_Ω Σ_j ⟨G(Du)e_j, Dζ e_j⟩ for every C¹ map ζ : ℝ^m → ℝ^k with compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ Ω, u is C^r on Ω for every r ∈ ℕ.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (G : (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k) → (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k)), 1 ≤ m → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G → G 0 = 0 → fderiv ℝ G 0 = 0 → ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ (Ω : Set (Euclid m)) (u : Euclid m → Euclid k), IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u Ω → (∀ x ∈ Ω, ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ ε₀) → (∀ ζ : Euclid m → Euclid k, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Ω → ∫ x in Ω, ∑ j : Fin m, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ u x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) = ∫ x in Ω, ∑ j : Fin m, inner ℝ (G (fderiv ℝ u x) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) → ∀ r : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ r u Ω
